text: Because banks and brokers had let LTCM borrow the full value of its collateral, LTCM's 4.8 billion dollars in capital dissipated quickly once banks began making margin calls.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Investment Fund Regulation - Theory and Empirical Evidence from 1998 to 2016 (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998097

isBasedOn.name: Private Investment Fund Regulation - Theory and Empirical Evidence from 1998 to 2016

abstract: Because banks and brokers had allowed LTCM to borrow 100 percent of the value of its collateral prior to the worsening of LTCM's financial condition in 1998, LTCM's $4.8 billion in capital dissipated quickly when the banks began to make margin calls.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: 100 percent collateral lending by banks and brokers
